messages:
kai: FYI I hit a blocker running the JS SDK sample-app on Cloudflare Pages + Netlify Edge. Auth/retry middleware throws when doing streaming responses. Works fine in Node.

rachel: Can you paste the stack + package.json exports?

kai: Stack:
```
TypeError: headers.get is not a function
    at buildAuthHeaders (dist/esm/auth.js:120:22)
    at retryRequest (dist/esm/retry.js:45:10)
```
package.json (relevant):
```
"main": "dist/cjs/index.js",
"module": "dist/esm/index.mjs",
"exports": {
  "./": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
    "default": "./dist/esm/index.mjs"
  }
}
```

dan: Edge runtimes + some bundlers pick the "default" (or "import") entry, which is fine, but our esm build assumes Response/Fetch Headers while our CJS path uses Node IncomingHttpHeaders. The middleware expects a Node-like header object in some code paths.

ivy: We should avoid branching behavior in runtime logic. Two approaches: 1) add an explicit "edge" condition in exports so edge resolvers pick dist/edge/index.mjs that wires fetch-based adapters; or 2) unify to one ESM output that is runtime-agnostic and use a small runtime adapter layer chosen by a conditional export mapping. I prefer #2 to reduce build artifacts.

rachel: +1 for single ESM source. Practical plan: keep src/auth and src/retry purely abstract (use HeaderAdapter interface), put node/fetch adapters under src/platforms, and at build emit dist/platform-node.mjs and dist/platform-edge.mjs. Then exports: 
```
"exports": {
  "./": {
    "node": "./dist/platform-node.mjs",
    "edge": "./dist/platform-edge.mjs",
    "default": "./dist/esm/index.mjs"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json",
  "./types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"
}
```

dan: Suggestion: for Node consumers that still use require(), ship a tiny CJS shim at dist/cjs/index.js that re-exports require('..'). That keeps require() working without maintaining heavy CJS builds.

ivy: About types: include a single d.ts and add top-level "types" + "typesVersions" mapping for older TS consumers. Example: 
```
"types": "dist/types/index.d.ts",
"typesVersions": { "*": { "*": ["dist/types/*"] } }
```

kai: CI changes: add GH Actions matrix job that runs Node (18) + Cloudflare wrangler + Netlify Edge emulator on each PR for the sample-apps repo. We also need a smoke E2E to verify auth/retry semantics (simulate 502 then success).

ci-bot: Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/499 - adds edge platform adapters, updates exports, single ESM source, and CI matrix for Pages/Netlify. Tests will run on push.

rachel: Nice. One more gotcha: bundlers like esbuild/rollup sometimes replace conditional exports resolution during bundling; recommend documenting how to import platform-agnostic entry (import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference') and not deep-import platform files.

dan: I'll start the auth adapter refactor and add unit tests for header abstraction. Kai, can you add the edge job to sample-apps CI?

kai: On it. Will also add a quick migration note for customers who consumed Node-only header shapes.

ivy: If we can keep runtime behavior identical across platforms AND keep CI green, we can avoid a full extra build. That should be our target for a patch release.

kai: Thanks everyone, I'll post the PR link once ready. :rocket:
